Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 108. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

U7/U6
Requires:Super Saiyan Grade 4 Power-Up
Your mastery of the Super Saiyan form has led you
down a path few can ever reach. Your Super Saiyan
form has become your base body and rage and unrest
are no longer required to use it. You always appear to be
in the Super Saiyan grade 4 state, though you don’t gain
the standard transformation benefits. You may no
longer use the Super Saiyan 1 transformation or the
Grades 2-4 Power-Ups alongside it. You gain 1 Rank of
the Light-Weight Condition. Your stamina also
permanently increases by 2.
